provenance.note:
In Philelphus’ book, marginal notes in a neat fifteenth-century humanist hand, light-brown-green ink, extracting key words. On the last leaf, after some notes in Latin and Greek, an inscription in Italian, dated 18 Mar. 1510: «In Christi nomine amen. Et sia noto et manifesto come la reuerentia fe patre Pietro de Bonetti se obliga a celebrare ogni sabbato una messa a la ecclesia de Sancta Maria de la Consolatione in Bressa Ad instantia de M.co. Io. Baptista di Bonetti suo fratello (?) questo come zanoso(?) adi 18 de Mazo 1510 [...] M.ro Zuanne di Bonetti suo padre [...]».
The note relates that father Pietro Bonetti, a priest, promises to celebrate a mass every Saturday in the church of S. Maria de la Consolazione, Brescia, on request of his brother, Giovanni Battista Bonetti, for some reason relating to their father, probably to commemorate his death.
on [*]1v, blank, of Philelphus’ book, in a shaky hand, brown ink: «Hic liber est Joannis Baptistae Beneuoli Brixiani grammatici».
